platform.title: Platform Role
platform.content: Borvi is a technical brokerage platform for rentals between private users. Rental agreements are concluded directly between provider and renter.

registration.title: Registration & Identity Verification
registration.content: Users must register and be of legal age. Borvi may request identity verification.

payment.title: Payment Processing
payment.content: Payments are processed via Stripe. Borvi does not store complete card details.

disputes.title: Payment Disputes & Chargebacks
disputes.content: Borvi is not responsible for payment disputes or chargebacks between users.

refund.title: Cancellation & Refund
refund.content: Cancellation conditions are agreed directly between provider and renter. Borvi does not guarantee refunds.

liability.title: Liability & Contractual Relationship
liability.content: Borvi is not a contractual party. Users are responsible for rented items, their condition and return.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked
FAQ.DESCRIPTION: Find answers about renting, payments, bookings, and using Borvi.
FAQ.CONTACT_DESC: Our team is happy to help you.

ITEM1.QUESTION: What is Borvi?
ITEM1.ANSWER: Borvi is a platform where users can rent products from other private users. Borvi only provides the technical platform. The rental agreement is created directly between the provider and the renter.

ITEM2.QUESTION: Who is my contracting partner in a rental?
ITEM2.ANSWER: The rental agreement is concluded directly between the provider and the renter. Borvi is not a contractual party.

ITEM3.QUESTION: How does the payment work?
ITEM3.ANSWER: Payments are processed securely through Stripe. Borvi does not store complete card information.

ITEM4.QUESTION: Can I cancel a booking?
ITEM4.ANSWER: Cancellation conditions are determined between the provider and the renter and may vary depending on the listing.

ITEM5.QUESTION: Is there a deposit or insurance through Borvi?
ITEM5.ANSWER: No. Borvi currently does not provide insurance coverage or deposit handling.

ITEM6.QUESTION: Why do I need to register?
ITEM6.ANSWER: Registration helps create a trusted community and allows secure communication and bookings.

ITEM7.QUESTION: How can I contact Borvi?
ITEM7.ANSWER: You can contact us anytime via hello@borvi.de.

story.titleHighlight: Renting Can Be Smarter Than Buying
story.paragraph1: Borvi was created around a simple belief — many of the things we need are expensive to buy and often used only once in a while. Instead of everyone purchasing the same tools, equipment, or outdoor gear, why not make them accessible to others when they're not being used?
story.paragraph2: Our platform connects people who need something with people who already own it. By making sharing and renting easy, Borvi helps communities save money, access equipment when they need it, and get more value from the things they already have.
story.paragraph3: We're building a trusted marketplace where renting becomes a natural alternative to buying — reducing waste, making resources go further, and creating benefits for both owners and renters.
